plane.basis: Known independent camera projection and metric grid in an authored synthetic video; not physical calibration.

activePathFit.interpretation: Explicitly accepted conditional fixed reference fitted from the same original marker observations after caller-declared plane rectification. Not a measured physical pivot. Angle-noise propagation conditions on this point and plane as exact, excluding their uncertainty.

reference.retention: Original point measurements, revisions and reference-fit membership remain in the identified Motion input file. Retain the separately identified original video for pixel reinspection.

conditioning.independence: A reference fit used source marker observations before any downstream derivative train/check split. Inspect referenceHistory; that split alone does not establish independently calibrated reference evidence.

initialRate.basis: Known independent authored oscillator derivative at release.
initialRate.qualification: Caller supplied; not inferred from future challenge positions or authenticated by the application.

assumptions.basis: Authored unforced scalar oscillators share metric plane axes; camera projections differ.
assumptions.qualification: User declarations, not a physical calibration or an authenticated independence guarantee.

metricPlane.qualification: Four exact correspondences do not independently verify the plane, metric aspect ratio, camera stability, lens model or physical calibration.
metricPlane.uncertainty: First-order propagation of declared independent isotropic pixel errors, conditional on exact plane correspondences and a fixed camera. Corner uncertainty, lens distortion and plane mismatch are excluded.

limitations: Angles use a caller-declared metric plane under a fixed camera with negligible lens distortion. Both points must lie in that plane; its metric aspect ratio and physical basis are not verified.
A visually plausible wrong pivot cannot be diagnosed from these coordinates alone.

A fitted path center is a conditional image reference, not a measured physical joint. Fixed-reference sigma does not include center-fit uncertainty or its correlation with the same marker observations.
No interpolation crosses a rejected measurement, time gap or excessive angular step.
Angle unwrapping assumes changes smaller than the declared limit; full hidden turns cannot be detected.
Position sigma is an assumed pixel-error propagation with an exact pivot, not calibrated tracking confidence.
Template correlation can remain high while rotation, perspective or deformation biases the tracked location.

motion.angleSamples: Unchanged Motion-derived times and unwrapped angles. No recentering, interpolation, torque command or physical inertia is introduced.
